paragraphs: Hi, I'm Shakirul Hasan Khan, a Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web applications and AI-powered solutions.
Currently working as a Software Engineer at Re:cruit, developing an AI-powered meeting transcription and contact management sidekick.
I specialize in full-stack development with expertise in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, and Rust. Passionate about creating user-centric applications with cutting-edge technology.
Besides I'm always building something cool.
